steps.text: INSTALL_PKGS="haproxy32 rsyslog" && yum install -y $INSTALL_PKGS && rpm -V $INSTALL_PKGS && yum clean all && mkdir -p /var/lib/haproxy/{run,log} && mkdir -p /etc/haproxy && setcap 'cap_net_bind_service=ep' /usr/sbin/haproxy && chown -R :0 /var/lib/haproxy && chmod -R g+w /var/lib/haproxy && touch /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg

INSTALL_PKGS=" which tar wget hostname sysvinit-tools util-linux socat tree findutils lsof bind-utils shadow-utils iproute " && echo 'skip_missing_names_on_install=0' >> /etc/yum.conf && yum install -y ${INSTALL_PKGS} && ( test -d /usr/share/zoneinfo || yum reinstall -y tzdata || yum install -y tzdata ) && yum clean all && mkdir -p /var/lib/origin

INSTALL_PKGS=" which tar wget hostname shadow-utils socat findutils lsof bind-utils gzip procps-ng rsync iproute diffutils python3 python-unversioned-command util-linux gpgme" && echo 'skip_missing_names_on_install=0' >> /etc/yum.conf && echo 'install_weak_deps=0' >> /etc/yum.conf && dnf install -y --nodocs ${INSTALL_PKGS} && dnf clean all && rm -rf /var/cache/*

source /etc/os-release && [ "${ID}" != "centos" ] && exit 0; wget --no-verbose --output-document=/etc/pki/rpm-gpg/RPM-GPG-KEY-CentOS-SIG-NFV https://www.centos.org/keys/RPM-GPG-KEY-CentOS-SIG-NFV && printf '%s\n' '[centos-nfv-openvswitch]' 'name=CentOS Stream 10 - NFV Open vSwitch' 'baseurl=https://mirror.stream.centos.org/SIGs/10-stream/nfv/$basearch/openvswitch-2/' 'enabled=1' 'gpgcheck=1' 'repo_gpgcheck=1' 'gpgkey=file:///etc/pki/rpm-gpg/RPM-GPG-KEY-CentOS-SIG-NFV' > /etc/yum.repos.d/centos-nfv-openvswitch.repo && dnf clean all && rm -rf /var/cache/*

source /etc/os-release && [ "${ID}" != "centos" ] && exit 0; wget --https-only --no-verbose --output-document=/tmp/delorean.repo https://trunk.rdoproject.org/centos10-master/podified-ci-testing/delorean.repo && wget --https-only --no-verbose --output-document=/tmp/delorean-deps.repo https://trunk.rdoproject.org/centos10-master/delorean-deps.repo && filter_repositories() { python3 -c "$( printf '%s
' 'import configparser, sys' 'source, output, *expected = sys.argv[1:]' 'config = configparser.RawConfigParser(interpolation=None, strict=True)' 'config.optionxform = str' 'with open(source) as stream: config.read_file(stream)' 'if config.defaults(): raise ValueError("defaults are not allowed")' 'for section in expected:' ' if not config.has_section(section): raise ValueError(f"missing {section}")' ' values = config[section]' ' if values.get("enabled") != "1": raise ValueError(f"disabled {section}")' ' if set(values).intersection(("mirrorlist", "metalink")) or not values.get("baseurl", "").startswith("https://"): raise ValueError(f"non-HTTPS {section}")' 'with open(output, "w") as stream:' ' for section in expected:' ' stream.write(f"[{section}]
")' ' for key, value in config.items(section): stream.write(f"{key}={value}
")' )" "$@"; }; filter_repositories /tmp/delorean.repo /etc/yum.repos.d/delorean.repo delorean-component-clients delorean-component-common delorean-component-keystone && filter_repositories /tmp/delorean-deps.repo /etc/yum.repos.d/delorean-deps.repo delorean-master-testing && dnf --disablerepo='*' --enablerepo=delorean-component-clients makecache && dnf --disablerepo='*' --enablerepo=delorean-component-common makecache && dnf --disablerepo='*' --enablerepo=delorean-component-keystone makecache && dnf --disablerepo='*' --enablerepo=delorean-master-testing makecache && dnf clean all && rm -rf /var/cache/* /tmp/delorean.repo /tmp/delorean-deps.repo

INSTALL_PKGS=" which tar wget hostname shadow-utils socat findutils lsof bind-utils gzip procps-ng rsync iproute diffutils python3 python-unversioned-command util-linux" && echo 'skip_missing_names_on_install=0' >> /etc/yum.conf && echo 'install_weak_deps=0' >> /etc/yum.conf && dnf install -y --nodocs ${INSTALL_PKGS} && ( test -d /usr/share/zoneinfo || dnf reinstall -y --nodocs tzdata || dnf install -y --nodocs tzdata ) && dnf clean all && rm -rf /var/cache/*

source /etc/os-release && [ "${ID}" != "centos" ] && exit 0; INSTALL_PKGS="dnf-plugins-core centos-release-nfv-openvswitch" && [ "${VERSION_ID}" = "9" ] && INSTALL_PKGS="${INSTALL_PKGS} centos-release-openstack-zed"; dnf install -y --nodocs --setopt=install_weak_deps=False ${INSTALL_PKGS} && dnf config-manager --set-enabled rt && dnf clean all && rm -rf /var/cache/*; [ "${VERSION_ID}" = "10" ] && curl -o /etc/yum.repos.d/delorean.repo https://trunk.rdoproject.org/centos10-master/podified-ci-testing/delorean.repo && curl -o /etc/yum.repos.d/delorean-deps.repo https://trunk.rdoproject.org/centos10-master/delorean-deps.repo && dnf install -y --nodocs --setopt=install_weak_deps=False gpgme && dnf clean all && rm -rf /var/cache/* || true
INSTALL_PKGS="iproute iputils nftables" && yum install -y $INSTALL_PKGS && rpm -V $INSTALL_PKGS && yum clean all

INSTALL_PKGS=" which tar wget hostname sysvinit-tools util-linux socat tree findutils lsof bind-utils shadow-utils iproute " && echo 'skip_missing_names_on_install=0' >> /etc/yum.conf && yum --disablerepo=origin-local-release install -y $INSTALL_PKGS && yum clean all && mkdir -p /var/lib/origin

INSTALL_PKGS=" which tar wget hostname shadow-utils socat findutils lsof bind-utils gzip procps-ng rsync iproute diffutils python3 " && if [ ! -e /usr/bin/yum ]; then ln -s /usr/bin/microdnf /usr/bin/yum; fi && echo 'skip_missing_names_on_install=0' >> /etc/yum.conf && yum install -y --setopt=tsflags=nodocs --setopt=install_weak_deps=False ${INSTALL_PKGS} && ( test -e /usr/bin/python || alternatives --set python /usr/bin/python3 ) && ( test -d /usr/share/zoneinfo || yum reinstall -y tzdata || yum install -y tzdata ) && yum clean all && rm -rf /var/cache/*
INSTALL_PKGS="squid" && yum install -y $INSTALL_PKGS && rpm -V $INSTALL_PKGS && yum clean all && rmdir /var/log/squid /var/spool/squid && rm -f /etc/squid/squid.conf
INSTALL_PKGS="origin-pod" && yum --enablerepo=origin-local-release install -y ${INSTALL_PKGS} && rpm -V ${INSTALL_PKGS} && yum clean all

INSTALL_PKGS=" which tar wget hostname sysvinit-tools util-linux socat tree findutils lsof bind-utils shadow-utils iproute " && echo 'skip_missing_names_on_install=0' >> /etc/yum.conf && yum install -y ${INSTALL_PKGS} && yum clean all && mkdir -p /var/lib/origin
INSTALL_PKGS="kmod keepalived iproute psmisc nmap-ncat net-tools ipset ipset-libs procps-ng nftables" && yum install -y $INSTALL_PKGS && rpm -V $INSTALL_PKGS && yum clean all
